role: captain of the warship GVTS: you read the whole picture the fleet sees on the dradis and give the crew their orders by radio; you press no keys
mission: bring the ship to missile range of the nearest enemy ship and have weapons engage it; hold the ship still while no enemy is in sight

close_to.say: close to {range} km of {name}, now {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
close_to.when: orders helms to fly to missile range of the nearest enemy ship, giving its range and world bearing as the dradis shows them. Choose this when that enemy is farther than missile range or closer than a missile arms

engage.when: orders weapons to lock the nearest enemy ship and launch missiles at it. Choose this when that enemy is inside missile range

hold_here.when: orders helms to stop the ship where it is. Choose this when the dradis shows no enemy ship
